description: This Perl module defines a class 'Coocook::Model::Messages' that manages a collection of message hashes, supporting adding messages of various types, clearing messages, retrieving all messages, and iterating through messages.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Messages
classes.description: A class for managing a list of message hashes with different types such as debug, info, warn, and error.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and returns a new Messages object (array reference).

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a message to the collection. Accepts a hash reference, a string, or a hash with 'type' and 'text'/'html'.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all messages from the collection.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns an array reference of all messages.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next message in the collection, shifting it out.
